profile.summary: A technology company that makes a communications platform for video meetings, phone calls, team chat, document collaboration and contact centers. It also offers products for schools and universities. The company was formerly named Zoom Video Communications, Inc. and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

review.notes: The agenda item is a student data privacy agreement with 'Zoom, Inc.' for a technology service, which fits the video and collaboration software company now named Zoom Communications, Inc. The 10-K confirms the legal name, San Jose address, phone and EIN, and the Zoom pages confirm the products and K-12 offerings; the summary is neutral and supported.
